message:
The other day, I was rummaging through our old storage bins when I stumbled upon our family go-bags. You know, those bags we put together long ago with the best intentions—but life got busy, and they ended up tucked away. I decided it was the perfect time for a little family gathering, so I invited the grandkids over for a ‘prepare-and-play’ day. 

We sorted through the bags, checked our supplies, and even turned it into a little scavenger hunt for snacks and cozy essentials. It felt nice to blend a bit of readiness with some laughter and bonding. Who knew that preparing for the unexpected could lead to such a sweet afternoon? 

Have you ever turned a task into a fun family moment?
